original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳前议长奥夸耶警告：行政机构恐吓反对派破坏权力分立
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳前议长阿伦·迈克·奥夸耶教授警告称，当行政机构利用国家机构恐吓或压制反对派成员时，权力分立原则将受到破坏。该表态由单一来源报道，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证。

key_facts.fact: 加纳前议长奥夸耶警告行政机构恐吓反对派会破坏权力分立
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former Speaker of Parliament, Prof. Aaron Mike Oquaye, has cautioned that the principle of separation of powers is undermined when the Executive uses state institutions to intimidate or silence members of the opposition.

key_facts.fact: 奥夸耶称其曾阻止特别检察官逮捕Bawku Central选区议员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prof. Mike Oquaye recounts how he blocked the Special Prosecutor’s attempt to arrest Bawku Central MP

uncertainties: 该表态目前仅由单一来源报道，尚未获得其他来源交叉验证
